purpose: Reduce and prevent practice financial leakage from lost referrals, staff/admin time waste, appointment leakage, unclear responsibility, handover failure, under-used capacity and recurring operating waste.

build_phases.name: Directive & IP Freeze
build_phases.green_gate: Signed/frozen product contract; no duplicate competing product; feature register versioned.

build_phases.name: Current-State Loss Map
build_phases.green_gate: Every target loss type has a defined current-state process, owner and measurable baseline.

build_phases.name: Savings Measurement Contract
build_phases.green_gate: No savings can be counted without a calculation method, baseline and evidence rule.

build_phases.name: Information Architecture & Role Matrix
build_phases.green_gate: Role matrix approved; no role receives unnecessary access.

build_phases.name: Repository & Environment Foundation
build_phases.green_gate: Clean install succeeds; CI passes; protected main exists; preview environment works with synthetic data.

build_phases.name: Authoritative Database Spine
build_phases.green_gate: Fresh database can be created from migrations; tenant/role isolation tests pass.

build_phases.name: Authentication, Authorisation & Audit
build_phases.green_gate: Unauthorised cross-user/cross-centre access is denied by API and database controls.

build_phases.name: Core Work Ownership Engine
build_phases.green_gate: An active item cannot silently lose ownership; overdue/transfer scenarios pass automated tests.

build_phases.name: No Lost Referral™
build_phases.green_gate: Every synthetic referral is traceable from receipt to final outcome with no invisible state.

build_phases.name: Reception Flow & Follow-up
build_phases.green_gate: Reception can work from one authoritative queue and no synthetic callback disappears.

build_phases.name: Appointment Leakage & Refill
build_phases.green_gate: Cancelled capacity can be tracked from vacancy to refill/no-refill and recovered value is auditable.

build_phases.name: Leave, Handover & Absence Continuity
build_phases.green_gate: No active priority work is orphaned during synthetic leave/absence tests.

build_phases.name: Staff Time Waste & Duplication
build_phases.green_gate: At least one end-to-end synthetic waste case reaches Verified savings with evidence.

build_phases.name: Capacity & Utilisation
build_phases.green_gate: Capacity metrics reconcile to synthetic source data and do not misclassify approved/non-working time.

build_phases.name: Recurring Cost & Supplier Waste
build_phases.green_gate: Annualised cost reductions are derived from recorded before/after values and evidence.

build_phases.name: Systemic Pattern, Waste & Prevention Command
build_phases.green_gate: Repeated synthetic events can be grouped, corrected and measured without corrupting individual event history.

build_phases.name: Verified Savings Ledger
build_phases.green_gate: Dashboard total can be reconstructed from underlying verified cases.

build_phases.name: Irene Director Command Dashboard
build_phases.green_gate: Every headline number is traceable; no dashboard value is a disconnected calculation.

build_phases.name: Alerts, Notifications & Accountability
build_phases.green_gate: Critical synthetic events alert the correct role once, escalate correctly and remain auditable.

build_phases.name: Full Regression, Security, Load & UAT
build_phases.green_gate: No critical/high defects; all core workflows GREEN; UAT sign-off recorded.

build_phases.name: Production Deployment & Controlled Pilot
build_phases.green_gate: Production environment healthy; pilot access controlled; monitoring and rollback ready.

build_phases.name: Baseline Period & First Verified Savings
build_phases.green_gate: First verified savings cases completed without double-counting or unsupported assumptions.

build_phases.name: Scale, Optimise & Prevent
build_phases.green_gate: System operates as a continuous prevention and savings-control cycle, not a one-off audit.
